page_title: COM 1-2 ACM | Como v AC Milan 14/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Assane Diao is replaced by Simone Verdi (Como).
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andrea Belotti (Como) comes onto the pitch so that Patrick Cutrone can be given a rest.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

87' Mike Maignan was forced into action to thwart Patrick Cutrone (Como). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
85' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Gianluca Manganiello didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) replaces Alberto Dossena.
85' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

85' Ambitious effort from Alberto Dossena (Como). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
84' Flag goes up against Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
83' Alberto Dossena (Como) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick is awarded to AC Milan.
80' Dangerous play by Patrick Cutrone (Como). Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan have a free kick.
76' 1 - 2 Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the middle of the goal.
73' Here is a change. Yannik Engelhardt is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Maximo Perrone (Como).
73' Youssouf Fofana comes off the pitch to be replaced by Francesco Camarda (AC Milan).
71' 1 - 1 What a goal that is! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Jean Butez and into the net. 1:1.
70' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
70' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Como.

69' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
68' It seemed like Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
67' The game has come to an end for Malick Thiaw. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan).
65' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) for a tough tackle.
64' A cross into the box from Emerson Royal (AC Milan) is cleared.

60' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Assane Diao (Como) displays superb quick feet and dribbling as he jinks his way through multiple challenges and takes a shot from inside the box, which is deflected and goes past stranded Mike Maignan. 1:0.
58' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Patrick Cutrone (Como) heads on.
56' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) sees a yellow card from Gianluca Manganiello after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
53' Today's referee Gianluca Manganiello rightly decides to book Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) for his harsh tackle.
53' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.

53' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Jean Butez, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
53' Assane Diao (Como) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
52' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Como win a free kick.
50' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) makes a strong challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul. Como will take a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Christian Pulisic is replaced by Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Sergio Conceicao gives a chance to Yunus Musah and Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) is off.
46' Cesc Fabregas has made a change at the break. Maxence Caqueret has come on in place of Gabriel Strefezza (Como).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Sergio Conceicao probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alvaro Morata. He is replaced by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan).
46' The whistle blows and Gianluca Manganiello starts the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45+1' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
45+1' It seems like Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' The foul by Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Gianluca Manganiello.
41' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
40' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
39' The corner by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
37' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.

36' Patrick Cutrone (Como) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gianluca Manganiello with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick to AC Milan.
33' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
31' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) commits a rough foul. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and makes a call. There is a free kick near the sideline to Como.

29' It's a free kick to AC Milan, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal. Alieu Fadera (Como) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Gianluca Manganiello blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
28' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
27' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) makes a slide tackle, but referee Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul. AC Milan have been awarded a free kick.
24' Gianluca Manganiello couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Assane Diao (Como) and blew his whistle.
24' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

23' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) quickly picks up the rebound and shoots towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
23' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Jean Butez is alert and denies him.
20' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Alvaro Morata (AC Milan), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
18' Alieu Fadera (Como) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Assane Diao was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.
17' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
17' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) was too forceful with his tackle and Gianluca Manganiello interrupted the game to signal a free kick. AC Milan earn a free kick.

14' A neat pass is well received by Gabriel Strefezza (Como), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
12' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Emerson Royal (AC Milan) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Como have a free kick.

10' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Jean Butez has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
9' The linesman raises his flag. Assane Diao (Como) is adjudged offside.

9' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
8' It seemed like Lucas Da Cunha (Como) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

8' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Como are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
7' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Mike Maignan makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
7' Assane Diao (Como) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
6' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for an infringement. Como get a free kick.
5' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
5' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
AC Milan will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Gianluca Manganiello.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
